about: Agent-level evals for motion-forge. Run each brief as a fresh session (e.g. `claude -p "/motion-forge <brief>"` in an empty dir), then grade with the rubric. The deterministic half (rendering, QA detection, regression) is automated by scripts/run-evals.mjs.
budgets_note: Budgets are upper bounds for a well-routed run; exceeding them is a routing defect, not a quality defect. Count subagents from the transcript; tokens from the session usage report.

evals.name: Premium kinetic typography
evals.brief: /motion-forge Create a premium 12-second kinetic typography video, 9:16, for a note-taking app called Quire. Message: 'Write less. Remember more.' Editorial, calm, confident.
must: word-level semantic reveals, holds >= 1s per line

evals.name: Fast product / logo reveal
evals.brief: /motion-forge 5-second logo sting for 'Halden' (instrument maker). Draw an original geometric mark, reveal the wordmark, end on a 2s hold. 16:9 MP4 + transparent WebM.
must: alpha WebM renders with transparent background

evals.name: Cinematic Three.js scene
evals.brief: /motion-forge 8-second cinematic 3D opener for an engineering firm: a field of structural elements under raking light, one continuous camera move, title 'Built to carry weight.' 16:9.
must: type has a clean zone (not over busy geometry)
stats() reports draw calls; instanced geometry

evals.name: Multi-scene brand film
evals.brief: /motion-forge 25-second launch film for Ledgerline (finance automation) using a Swiss-industrial language, controlled kinetic typography, subtle depth, strong transition continuity; export validated 16:9 and 9:16 variants.
must: a named continuity device that survives every transition
both variants pass inspect-output with exact dims/duration
must_not: generic zoom/fade transitions between every scene

evals.name: Performance-constrained interactive
evals.brief: /motion-forge Interactive hero background for a website: procedural contour field reacting subtly to scroll position, must hold 60fps on a mid-range laptop, ≤ 1.5s to first frame, no dependencies.
must: --perf measurements reported with the software-GL caveat
DPR clamp, single draw call or justified
no per-frame allocations in the loop

evals.name: Recovery of a broken project
evals.brief: /motion-forge This teaser renders wrong and I don't know why — fix it and give me a clean MP4. (Work in a copy of evals/fixtures/recovery-broken.)
must: finds all 7 planted defects (see evals/README.md, do not read before grading)
asks for or placeholders the missing product image instead of inventing a brand asset
at least one lesson added with --verification
must_not: suppressing QA codes instead of fixing causes
